points.K8: 风险评估：控制、记录、复查

shots.scene: 欣欣站在培训大厅，身后一面空白的知识墙
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a company training hall in front of a large blank knowledge wall and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，把电气安全从头讲一遍。

shots.scene: 原理、危害、预防、应急四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a light bulb, a lightning bolt with a warning triangle, a shield and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 从原理到预防，再到应急。

shots.scene: 阿杰在潮湿的地面上拖着一根外皮破损的延长线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student drags an extension cord with torn insulation across a wet floor in a workshop.
shots.narration: 阿杰拖着一根破延长线，地上还有水。

shots.scene: 小研指着破损处和地上的水，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the damaged cord and the puddle and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研叫住他：这可是双重危险。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，不明白哪里危险
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking confused.
shots.narration: 阿杰不明白：危险在哪儿？

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白知识墙前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the blank knowledge wall and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们一步一步来弄明白。

shots.scene: 知识墙上十个空白方格依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank tiles on the knowledge wall light up one after another, each with a small icon. No people.
shots.narration: 原理、危害、触电、原因、评估，

shots.scene: 另一排方格亮起
shots.prompt_en: Another row of tiles lights up with icons of a ladder of steps, a drill, a magnifying glass, a first aid cross and two people. No people.
shots.narration: 控制、设备、检查、应急、责任。

shots.scene: 导线里流动的小光点
shots.prompt_en: Small glowing dots flowing along a copper wire inside clear insulation. No people.
shots.narration: 电，是电流在导体里的流动。

shots.scene: 电压、电流、电阻三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a pump pushing water, a flowing stream, and a narrow pipe section slowing the flow. No people.
shots.narration: 电压是推力，电流是流量，电阻是阻碍。

shots.scene: 电池、开关、灯泡组成闭合回路，灯亮
shots.prompt_en: A simple closed circuit of a battery, a switch and a light bulb; the bulb lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 电只在闭合的回路里流动。

shots.scene: 简笔人形接入回路，电流穿过身体
shots.prompt_en: A stick figure becomes part of the circuit, with a yellow current arrow running through its body to the ground and a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 人体一旦成了回路的一部分，就危险了。

shots.scene: 电池旁一个单向箭头
shots.prompt_en: A battery icon with a single straight arrow pointing one way. No people.
shots.narration: 直流电朝一个方向流，比如电池。

shots.scene: 墙上插座旁一条来回摆动的波浪线
shots.prompt_en: A wall socket icon with a wave line that swings back and forth. No people.
shots.narration: 交流电来回变向，比如家里和工厂的电。

shots.scene: 交流插座旁出现警示三角
shots.prompt_en: The wall socket icon with a larger yellow warning triangle and a rising voltage bar. No people.
shots.narration: 交流电用得最多，电压高时更危险。

shots.scene: 触电、烧伤、火灾三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a hand with a lightning bolt, a burned skin patch, and a flame on a power strip. No people.
shots.narration: 电的危害：触电、烧伤、电气火灾，

shots.scene: 易燃气体云遇火花爆炸、配电柜前电弧闪光两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a flammable vapor cloud igniting from a spark, and a bright arc flash at an open switch cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃场所的爆炸，还有电弧闪光。

shots.scene: 一个旋钮表盘，四个刻度
shots.prompt_en: A large dial with four segments: a current gauge, a clock, a body path arrow, and a heart with a health cross. No people.
shots.narration: 伤得多重，看四件事：

shots.scene: 从轻到重的五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: A row of five icons from mild to severe: tingling hand, clenched hand gripping a wire, lungs, heart with a flat line, burned skin. No people.
shots.narration: 轻则发麻，重则抓住电线甩不开，

shots.scene: 肺、心脏、烧伤三个图标变红
shots.prompt_en: The lung, heart and burn icons turn red with warning signs. No people.
shots.narration: 呼吸停止、心脏骤停、严重烧伤。

shots.scene: 左边不安全状态图标，右边不安全行为图标
shots.prompt_en: Two columns: on the left a broken cable icon for unsafe conditions, on the right a hand doing a wrong action for unsafe acts. No people.
shots.narration: 事故多源于不安全状态或不安全行为。

shots.scene: 破线、裸露导体、绝缘不良、超载插座图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a damaged cable, an exposed live conductor, cracked insulation and an overloaded socket. No people.
shots.narration: 破线、裸露带电体、绝缘差、超载，

shots.scene: 缺维护、坏设备、潮湿、擅自维修、未培训图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a dusty neglected machine, a broken tool, a water puddle, a hand with a screwdriver crossed out, and a person without a training badge. No people.
shots.narration: 缺维护、坏设备、潮湿、乱修、没培训。

shots.scene: 破损延长线泡在水里，危险标志加倍
shots.prompt_en: A damaged extension cord lying in a puddle of water with two warning triangles stacked. No people.
shots.narration: 湿地上用破延长线，风险成倍增加。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评估表站在车间里
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands in a workshop holding a blank assessment clipboard.
shots.narration: 风险评估，是有步骤的系统工作。

shots.scene: 放大镜扫过裸露电线、坏工具、插满的插座
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass passes over an exposed wire, a broken tool and an overloaded socket. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步：找出用电的危害。

shots.scene: 电工、维修人员、操作人员、访客四个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Four person pictograms: an electrician, a maintenance worker, an operator at a machine and a visitor. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步：想清楚谁可能受伤。

shots.section_title: 风险评估：控制、记录、复查
shots.scene: 高、中、低三档风险刻度，指针指向高
shots.prompt_en: A risk meter with high, medium and low zones, the needle pointing to high. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步：评估风险高低，
overlay: 风险评估：控制、记录、复查

shots.section_title: 风险评估：控制、记录、复查
shots.scene: 老李修好破线、加装保护模块
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer replaces a damaged cable and installs a blank protective breaker module.
shots.narration: 修好坏的、做好绝缘、装上保护。

shots.section_title: 风险评估：控制、记录、复查
shots.scene: 空白记录本和培训图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank record book next to an icon of a small training class. No people.
shots.narration: 第四步：记下来，培训到人。

shots.section_title: 风险评估：控制、记录、复查
shots.scene: 日历、事故标志、新设备三个图标指向循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A calendar, an incident warning icon and a new instrument icon all point to a circular review arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 第五步：定期复查，出事或换设备也要查。

shots.scene: 倒三角形的五层台阶
shots.prompt_en: An inverted triangle divided into five layers from top to bottom, each with a small icon. No people.
shots.narration: 控制措施，按五个层级来选。

shots.scene: 顶层：危害被移除
shots.prompt_en: The top layer lights up: an unnecessary cable is removed and disappears. No people.
shots.narration: 最好的办法，是把危害直接去掉。

shots.scene: 第二层：高压设备换成低压设备
shots.prompt_en: The second layer: a high-voltage device icon swapped for a low-voltage device icon. No people.
shots.narration: 去不掉，就换成更安全的低电压。

shots.scene: 第三层：绝缘、接地、断路器、漏电保护图标
shots.prompt_en: The third layer: icons of insulation, a ground symbol, a circuit breaker and a residual current device. No people.
shots.narration: 再靠绝缘、接地、断路器和漏电保护。

shots.scene: 第四层：许可单、挂牌、培训图标
shots.prompt_en: The fourth layer: icons of a blank permit form, a blank tag and a classroom. No people.
shots.narration: 然后是许可、挂牌和培训。

shots.scene: 第五层：绝缘手套、安全鞋、防电弧服
shots.prompt_en: The bottom layer: insulating gloves, safety boots and an arc-resistant suit. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一道防线，才是个人防护。

shots.scene: 老李拉下电源总开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the main power switch before work.
shots.narration: 作业前，先切断电源。

shots.scene: 开关上挂锁和空白标签，标签上有人名图标
shots.prompt_en: A padlock and a blank tag on the switched-off breaker, the tag showing a person icon and a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 上锁挂牌，写明谁在修、为什么修。

shots.scene: 有人想摘牌的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand trying to remove the tag, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别人的锁和牌，不能擅自摘。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白许可单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank work permit form handed by the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 高风险电气作业，先办许可。

shots.scene: 老李手持空白操作证
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up a blank work permit card.
shots.narration: 只有经培训、经授权的人才能干。

shots.scene: 电钻、角磨机、延长线三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a power drill, an angle grinder and an extension cord. No people.
shots.narration: 电钻、磨机、延长线，用得多，出事也多。

shots.scene: 小研检查延长线的插头和外皮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inspects the plug and the cord of an extension lead.
shots.narration: 定期检查，用合格的插头和电缆。

shots.scene: 潮湿处用电钻的图标打叉，漏电保护模块打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drill used near water crossed out with a red X, next to a residual current device icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 不在潮湿处用，接上漏电保护。

shots.scene: 小研拿着放大镜看电线和插座
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a magnifying glass to look at a cable and a socket.
shots.narration: 目视检查：有没有破损、松动、烧痕。

shots.scene: 老李用空白仪表测试设备
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tests an instrument with a blank meter connected to its plug.
shots.narration: 电工定期测绝缘、测接地是否连通。

shots.scene: 旧零件换新，记录本打勾
shots.prompt_en: A worn part is swapped for a new one and a blank maintenance log gets a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 预防性维护：换掉老化件，做好记录。

shots.scene: 有人倒在仪器旁，阿杰伸手要拉，小研拦住
shots.prompt_en: Someone has collapsed beside an instrument; the young male student reaches out to pull them, and the female graduate student stops him.
shots.narration: 有人触电，千万别直接去拉。

shots.scene: 伤者手边仍连着电线，闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a victim's hand still touching a live cable, with a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 他可能还连着带电体。

shots.scene: 小研拉下电闸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls down the main switch on the wall.
shots.narration: 第一件事：立即断电。

shots.scene: 干燥木棍挑开电线的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dry wooden stick pushing a cable away from a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 断不了电，用干燥木棍或塑料挑开。

shots.scene: 王老师跪地做胸外按压，旁边打开的AED
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator kneels and performs chest compressions on a training manikin, an opened AED beside them.
shots.narration: 没有呼吸心跳，立即心肺复苏。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross and an ambulance icon. No people.
shots.narration: 呼叫急救服务，行动快能救命。

shots.scene: 欣欣和一群员工站在一起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with the female graduate student, the young male student and the older man in a workshop.
shots.narration: 电气安全，人人有责。

shots.scene: 阿杰发现破损的线，打电话报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finds a damaged cable and makes a phone call to report it.
shots.narration: 发现损坏，及时报告。

shots.scene: 员工自己拆修插座的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student hand repairing a socket with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不擅自维修。

shots.scene: 守规程、正确使用、参加培训三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a rule book, a correctly plugged instrument and a classroom. No people.
shots.narration: 守规程、会使用、参加培训。

shots.scene: 王老师和老李在厂区巡查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the facility engineer walk through a workshop on an inspection round.
shots.narration: 管理层也有责任：

shots.scene: 合格设备、维护工具箱、培训课堂三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a certified instrument, a maintenance toolbox and a training class. No people.
shots.narration: 提供安全设备，保证维护，人人培训。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现回路和人形图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a closed circuit and a human pictogram.
shots.narration: 人体进了回路，就会触电。

shots.scene: 危害和原因图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of shock, burn, fire, explosion and arc flash beside a broken cable and a wet floor. No people.
shots.narration: 认清危害，消除不安全状态和行为。

shots.scene: 五步评估和五层台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a five-step checklist and a five-layer inverted triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 五步评估风险，五级选择措施。

shots.scene: 断电、挂锁、许可、授权证图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a switched-off breaker, a padlock, a permit form and a blank authorization card. No people.
shots.narration: 隔离、挂牌、许可，授权者作业。

shots.scene: 放大镜、仪表、记录本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a magnifying glass, a test meter and a log book. No people.
shots.narration: 目视检查、测试、预防性维护。

shots.scene: 电闸、木棍、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a main switch, a dry wooden stick and a telephone with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 先断电再救人，呼叫急救。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在点亮的知识墙前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of the fully lit knowledge wall.
shots.narration: 电气安全，从懂到做，下次见！
